title: Bubble Gum
lyrics:
[00:18.14]Sorry I didn't kiss you
[00:24.19]But it's obvious I wanted to
[00:32.21]Bubble gum down my throat and it's a curse
[00:38.57]But my luck couldn't get any worse
[00:45.17]'Cause I swallowed the bubble gum
[00:52.49]Oh, and these seven years will be pretty dumb
[01:00.38]Pink flowers grow from my skin
[01:07.46]Pepto-Bismol veins, and I grin
[01:28.41]You look so nice in your shirt
[01:35.04]It's sad because it just hurts
[01:42.32]I'd do anything for you
[01:48.83]But would you do that for me, too?
[01:54.58]'Cause I swallowed the bubble gum
[02:01.57]Oh, and these seven years will be pretty dumb, oh
